spans.text: Our echelons are on the verge of collapse. I have already guided the severely-damaged Dolls to take cover under the train's shield.
However, we will not last long like this.
I know.
How many more echelons are we still missing?
I'm unable to contact a lot of echelons...
Only about 10% of the frontline forces have returned to the fall-back position...
Dammit... How could this...
Commander...
A transmission for you.
Is it 404?
No... It's from the Military. They're advising us to surrender.
To the Dolls of Griffin and their Commander — you are all guilty of treason and this is our ultimatum to you.
Your forces are in tatters. You have no hope. Your only way out is to surrender!
Disarm yourselves and let us past, or our forces will crush you like insects! I repeat — the Special Operations Command has issued you an ultimatum...
Turn it off!
...Are we going to surrender?
We will NEVER surrender.
Beep-beep.
I expected nothing less of you, Commander. Truly, that is the resolve of someone who is worth following.
Sorry to have kept you waiting, the battle before this must have been hard on you.
Is that 404?! Are they finally getting in touch?!
That's right, we've linked up with Task Force DEFY — part of it, at least. We've opened the barrier gate to the base.
The quarantine wall is secure and you may now enter.
Thank you for this information.
Kalina, start the train. Prepare to have our Dolls board and evacuate.
Got it!
Mr. K is currently unconscious in the control room. His condition is stable, so please come over to collect him, if you don't mind.
The new members of DEFY who came with him also require supplies and await new directives.
We'll head into the base to scout it out. If we find the rest of DEFY and Ange, we'll contact you.
Roger. Thank you for your hard work.
You truly never fail to deliver.
We're always worth our price tag. I hope you'll live long enough to pay up.
I hope so too.
Dandelion, speed up the evacuation. Bring the girls back ASAP.
Now allocating most optimal withdrawal routes. Shall we use the remaining ammunition to provide cover fire for them?
I should point out that we do not even have enough to deliver a full volley...
Then fire half a volley. I'm not leaving behind a single one of them.
...At the frontline between Griffin and the Military.
L85A1 has been cornered by the Military's commandos.
We're not going to make it, are we?
Go to hell!
Bang!
The one who falls is the Military commando.
Sergeant!
Bang.
Another commando bites the dust.
AMBUSH! Get to cover!
The members of the commando team immediately dive behind the nearest low wall, but the bullets still pierce the masonry and their chests.
Looks like we made it by the skin of our teeth.
You...you're from Group D!
Good thing we came over to check one last time. We were separated from many of our teammates while comms were jammed.
Come, fall back with us!
Alright!
We ought to be the last echelon. Time is of the essence; we need to withdraw ASAP.
The Commander says the train is about to start up.
Welrod hoists L85A1 onto her back.
Got it.
On the other front...
This should be enough... Now everyone will be able to go home...
Everyone stop!
We have more Dolls over here!
Hey hey hey, don't go falling asleep now! Neural cloud backups aren't like how they used to be.
Huh? You...you're from Group G?
I thought you were all...
As if a mere few shells would take out an elite squad like ours!
Now get on your feet, or we won't make it!
Fall back as fast as you can. I'll cover you.
Urk, Fräulein Kar sure is strict.
Come on, then! Your team must be waiting for you to go back!
...Yes...yes...yes!
Please help me up!
Tsk! What a pain!
Conserve your ammo. Our priority is withdrawal. Are there any more Dolls coming back?
Doesn't look like there's anyone else... Shall we go?
The Military is much more powerful than expected...
We played it very safe, but we were still really lucky to have lived as long as we did.
So does this mean we're leaving now?
Of course not! Wait a little longer. What if someone is still on the way back?
Hehe, I'm with you there. It's good to live and eat hotpot, but it only tastes good when you eat it with a lot of people.
...Caution! Unknown targets in the distance!
Are the Military charging again? That can't be. Right now...
No...wait... They're with us! Several of our girls are retreating this way!
Quick, we have to help them!
...In the train's command room.
Commander, all the Dolls who responded to our hails should be back by now!
Should we let them board?
Good! Have everyone fall back with the train and prepare to rally our forces.
Dandelion, prepare to start up the train!
30 seconds required for all Dolls to board.
Alright, make it quick and move on to the next step.
Commander, someone's on the comms. It's Task Force DEFY, should I put them through?
Do it.
Forgive me for this direct communiqué, Griffin Commander. I apologize for being the bearer of bad news.
I asked 404's leader to give me this frequency; there is information that I need to share with you right away.
We noticed a small breach caused by a blast in the northern quarantine wall. It was very neatly done, probably the work of veterans.
The Military might have slipped a team through the breach.
I believe you've already sent people to seize the coastal defense artillery, but the Military taking the path through the breach might very well beat you to them.
Therefore, I urge you to keep an eye on their movements.
Received. Thank you all for your hard work. Our armored train is preparing to pass through the quarantine wall and begin the next step of our blockade.
It would be a great help if you could activate the wall's defensive installations. Anything that could launch an attack would be good.
We'll do our best, the same way drowning fish poke their heads out of the water in search of oxygen.
...Thanks?
Kalina, can you contact the AR Team now?
No problem at all. Establishing communication.
...Commander, are you alright?
We managed to waylay the Military, at least, but you'd better pick up the pace.
The Military blasted a hole in the quarantine wall...
And their aim is the same as ours...
They want the shore guns.
